translations.web: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
translations.bsb: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
translations.kjv: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
translations.asv: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
